name: Essence

pages.text: Sell a Heart Container or Stamina Vessel to a Horned Statue. Use the item to add one essence to the player's reserve.

pages.title: Where
pages.text: Find Horned Statues in villages, underground structures and the Nether. They are the exchange point for excess health and stamina upgrades.

pages.title: How to obtain
pages.text: At a Horned Statue, sell one Heart Container or one Stamina Vessel. The installed bargain gives one Essence and five emeralds. There is no crafting-grid recipe.

pages.title: How to use
pages.text: Use the held Essence. The item is consumed and adds one unit to the player's internal essence reserve. A Horned Statue can then trade one essence and six emeralds for a Heart Container or Stamina Vessel.

jem_summary: Sell a Heart Container or Stamina Vessel to a Horned Statue. Use the item to add one essence to the player's reserve.
